mechanism.summary: T069: precompute immutable parameter/capture/frame initialization metadata once per bytecode body; seed ordinary synchronous positional arguments directly into slots before capture cells are initialized, retaining the existing parameter prologue and call-kind dispatch. Materialize compatibility call bindings only where their semantics require them. Existing direct/compact paths keep priority; realm/module/private/host services remain available without borrowing or replacing the caller binding view. Target rule, fixed from T068 development profiles only: calls-plus-environments exclusive self >=18 percent (five programs). T022 overall-first acceptance is declared before results: development lane, external lane, equal-case all-case portfolio and held-out are overall gates; single-lane ceilings, individual sentinels/microbenchmarks and RSS are local gates reported to the lead, who decides promotion. Correctness and zero Test262 gaps are never waivable. Peak RSS uses >=15 alternating pairs, per-case median ratio <=1.10 and development geomean <=1.05; retain T067 host-derived size/fresh/RSS resource evidence.
mechanism.generality: Metadata depends only on immutable bytecode local/capture flags and compiled parameter slots. Positional entry is admitted by synchronous execution, absence of observable parameter-name/mapped-arguments/dynamic-scope requirements, and preserved special-call context. It applies equally to JS calls, native callbacks and forwarded bound/proxy calls reaching the ordinary dispatcher. No workload/source/bytecode-template matching, new shared VM stack, operand/register transfer rewrite, dependency or unsafe code.
semantic_risks: Seed duplicate positional parameters in source order; preserve missing and extra arguments, defaults, destructuring, rest and parameter TDZ through the existing prologue.
Capture cells must be created after slot seeding and remain shared by declaring frames, escaping and sibling closures; precomputed routes cannot cache realm-specific cell identities.
Mapped arguments, direct eval, with, inherited deopt scopes, immutable self names and synthetic foreign-realm overlays keep compatibility setup where positional omission could change name resolution.

Preserve lexical this/arguments/new.target, super/private state, derived constructors, module live imports/exports, native coercion and callback restoration; generator/async suspended frames continue owning their environment.
Static frame plans must preserve compiler temporary, hoisted, global, incoming-upvalue and module precedence; names above the 128-bit mask range retain the existing slow route.

CPU-work removal is instruction-visible, but layout/codegen can affect untouched executors. Use fixed quick-triage controls, full policy screens, mandatory K=6, 30-block formal and 30-pair held-out. No decide/promotion by this owner.
